title: Virtual Compute: snapshot review — local subtotal
content:
## Calculation basis

Virtual Compute snapshot review — Multiply the allocated GB-month by snapshot storage rate, then reduce that original subtotal once by the backup portfolio discount fraction; apply no compute primary, campaign or commitment discount.

Virtual Compute snapshot review — Record the remaining nonnegative corrected local-snapshot pretax subtotal, rounding half-up to two USD decimals only at this final review step; zero subtotal stays zero.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the judgement for snapshot review — local subtotal?**

Record the remaining nonnegative corrected local-snapshot pretax subtotal, rounding half-up to two USD decimals only at this final review step; zero subtotal stays zero.

## Hypothetical case

Hypothetically, allocated compute usage is 25 GB-month, its snapshot price is 0.07 USD per GB-month and the backup reduction is 10%. The original subtotal is 1.75 USD; reducing once produces 1.575 USD. Final half-up rounding gives 1.58 USD. Zero attributed usage gives zero subtotal.
